candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Simulator Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive practice sub-flow to the finish screen where users can test dragging, hiding, and talking to their pet before completing setup.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after onboarding, and past finish new_flow changes won 2 out of 5 tests.

home_intro.headline: Try out your desktop pet controls now!

new_desktop_sim.headline: Practice Controlling Your Pet
new_desktop_sim.body: Click and drag your pet across the screen or right-click to access controls and settings.

guard.reason: Adds a valid interactive practice sub-flow after the home intro while retaining all required onboarding steps.

candidates.score_note: Finish new_flow has positive historical win rate (2/5 tests), but building an interactive simulator sub-flow is high effort.

candidates.title: Desktop Hatching Companion Activity Feed Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated activity feed screen during pet rendering that shows real-time companion asset creation status updates.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s), and home wait_info changes have succeeded in 4 out of 7 tests.

new_hatching_feed.headline: Your Companion is Being Created
new_hatching_feed.body: We are generating your custom pet traits and desktop animations.

guard.reason: Inserts a valid activity feed screen during the pet waiting phase without removing any mandatory steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen to home conflicts with wait_info successes and home new_screen changes previously lost conversion (-1.4%).

candidates.title: Sign-In Multi-Device Pet Restoration Hint
candidates.change: Displays explicit reassurance text under sign-in choices explaining that logging in restores any existing pet progress across devices.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign-in hints have won 5 out of 11 tests previously.

sign_in.hint: Signing in restores all your previously adopted desktop pets automatically across all your devices.

guard.reason: Adds helpful sign-in reassurance copy without violating data, pricing, or fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment with 8 support tickets and consistent positive track record for sign-in hints (5/11 wins, +2.1% avg).

candidates.title: Finish Companion Interaction Shortcut Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the finish screen into a full-bleed visual layout displaying key mouse gestures and desktop pet shortcuts.
candidates.why: Multiple users were confused about how to hide or interact with pets after onboarding, and finish step improvements help drive final onboarding completion.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Double-click to chat, drag to reposition, or right-click to open pet settings anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro layout while retaining its core function and staying within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns consistently fail across onboarding steps, with finish redesign previously dropping conversion by -6.6%.

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Stage Progress Checklist Display
candidates.change: Adds a stage-by-stage checklist component on the waiting screen to give real-time updates on pet model generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pet generation failing or stalling, and wait_info changes on home step have a 4/7 win record.

candidates.title: Desktop Rendering Completion Sound & Alert Switch
candidates.change: Adds a sound notification switch and system alert checkbox on the waiting screen so users know when rendering finishes.
candidates.why: The home wait step takes median 201s (mean 2336s); notifying users when ready prevents them from abandoning the app while waiting.

guard.reason: Adds an optional sound notification toggle on the waiting screen without modifying out-of-onboarding settings.

candidates.score_note: Addresses severe home wait time (2336s mean); home notifications performed strongly (+3.5%) across prior tests.

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Pet Asset Recovery Guarantee Hint
candidates.change: Adds reassuring hint text below authentication buttons confirming that account login safeguards custom pets from being reset.
candidates.why: 8 users emailed support about missing or reset pets post-login, making sign-in security reassurance a high-leverage opportunity.

sign_in.hint: Your pet customization and progress are safely tied to your account and will never be reset.

guard.reason: Adds helpful hint text reassuring account progress preservation on the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost text hint addressing explicit 8 support tickets regarding account pet safety; sign-in hints consistently perform well.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Preview Verification Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Introduces a pet photo visual preview step immediately following photo upload to confirm output quality before adoption.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption, which currently suffers a 66.0% conversion rate.

new_photo_preview.headline: Preview Your Custom Pet
new_photo_preview.body: Here is how your custom pet will look on your desktop. You can adjust your photo or proceed to adopt.

guard.reason: Asks for personal information by referencing the user's photo.

candidates.title: Choose Path Account Data Transfer Hint
candidates.change: Adds a clear hint on the path selection screen confirming that choosing a path preserves all desktop settings and saved data.
candidates.why: Addresses recurring user anxiety regarding data loss or pet resets when choosing onboarding options.

choose_path.hint: Your selection here can be changed anytime in settings without losing your saved pets or data.

guard.reason: Adds informative hint text on the path selection screen regarding settings and data preservation.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost text change on high-drop step (20.3% loss), though choose_path hints show only slight historically modest lift (+0.2%).

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Asset Construction Live Timer Display
candidates.change: Displays an active countdown timer alongside time estimates on the waiting screen while pet assets are being built.
candidates.why: High mean wait time (2336s) during home step leads to drop-offs; live wait info has proven effective in improving home retention.

guard.reason: Adds a timer display during an actual wait on the waiting screen, which is permitted under Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info improvements have proven reliable (4/7 wins, +2.0% avg), directly mitigating extreme long wait times.
